catalog_category_archival_timestamp_chec.name: catalog_category_archival_timestamp_check
catalog_category_archival_timestamp_chec.value: ("catalog_category"."status" = 'archived' AND "catalog_category"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("catalog_category"."status" <> 'archived' AND "catalog_category"."archived_at" IS NULL)

catalog_product_brand_check.name: catalog_product_brand_check
catalog_product_brand_check.value: "catalog_product"."brand" IS NULL OR ("catalog_product"."brand" = btrim("catalog_product"."brand") AND char_length("catalog_product"."brand") BETWEEN 1 AND 120)

catalog_product_tr_slug_check.name: catalog_product_tr_slug_check
catalog_product_tr_slug_check.value: "catalog_product"."tr_slug" IS NULL OR (char_length("catalog_product"."tr_slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND "catalog_product"."tr_slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$')

catalog_product_uk_slug_check.name: catalog_product_uk_slug_check
catalog_product_uk_slug_check.value: "catalog_product"."uk_slug" IS NULL OR (char_length("catalog_product"."uk_slug") BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND "catalog_product"."uk_slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$')

catalog_product_mpn_check.name: catalog_product_mpn_check
catalog_product_mpn_check.value: "catalog_product"."mpn" IS NULL OR ("catalog_product"."mpn" = btrim("catalog_product"."mpn") AND char_length("catalog_product"."mpn") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

catalog_product_commerce_check.name: catalog_product_commerce_check
catalog_product_commerce_check.value:
(
        "catalog_product"."sales_mode" = 'direct_purchase'
        AND "catalog_product"."availability" IN ('in_stock', 'out_of_stock')
        AND "catalog_product"."price_presentation" = 'exact'
        AND "catalog_product"."price_entry_basis" IN ('vat_inclusive', 'vat_exclusive')
        AND "catalog_product"."price_input_minor" > 0
      ) OR (
        "catalog_product"."sales_mode" = 'enquiry'
        AND "catalog_product"."availability" IS NULL
        AND (
          ("catalog_product"."price_presentation" IN ('exact', 'from')
            AND "catalog_product"."price_entry_basis" IN ('vat_inclusive', 'vat_exclusive')
            AND "catalog_product"."price_input_minor" > 0)
          OR
          ("catalog_product"."price_presentation" = 'on_request'
            AND "catalog_product"."price_entry_basis" IS NULL
            AND "catalog_product"."price_input_minor" IS NULL)
        )
      )

catalog_product_archival_timestamp_check.name: catalog_product_archival_timestamp_check
catalog_product_archival_timestamp_check.value: ("catalog_product"."status" = 'archived' AND "catalog_product"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("catalog_product"."status" <> 'archived' AND "catalog_product"."archived_at" IS NULL)

catalog_promotion_value_check.name: catalog_promotion_value_check
catalog_promotion_value_check.value:
(
        "catalog_promotion"."discount_type" = 'percentage'
        AND "catalog_promotion"."percentage_basis_points" BETWEEN 1 AND 9999
        AND "catalog_promotion"."fixed_vat_inclusive_minor" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "catalog_promotion"."discount_type" = 'fixed_eur'
        AND "catalog_promotion"."percentage_basis_points" IS NULL
        AND "catalog_promotion"."fixed_vat_inclusive_minor" > 0
      )

catalog_promotion_schedule_check.name: catalog_promotion_schedule_check
catalog_promotion_schedule_check.value: "catalog_promotion"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "catalog_promotion"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "catalog_promotion"."ends_at" > "catalog_promotion"."starts_at"

catalog_promotion_translation_public_lab.name: catalog_promotion_translation_public_label_check
catalog_promotion_translation_public_lab.value: "catalog_promotion_translation"."public_label" IS NULL OR ("catalog_promotion_translation"."public_label" = btrim("catalog_promotion_translation"."public_label") AND char_length("catalog_promotion_translation"."public_label") BETWEEN 1 AND 200)

catalog_product_media_source_check.name: catalog_product_media_source_check
catalog_product_media_source_check.value: ("catalog_product_media"."reference" IS NOT NULL) <> ("catalog_product_media"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL)

catalog_asset_upload_target_check.name: catalog_asset_upload_target_check
catalog_asset_upload_target_check.value:
(
        "catalog_asset_upload"."purpose" IN ('product_image', 'product_document')
        AND "catalog_asset_upload"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "catalog_asset_upload"."category_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "catalog_asset_upload"."purpose" = 'category_cover'
        AND "catalog_asset_upload"."product_id" IS NULL AND "catalog_asset_upload"."category_id" IS NOT NULL
      )

catalog_managed_asset_dimensions_check.name: catalog_managed_asset_dimensions_check
catalog_managed_asset_dimensions_check.value:
(
        "catalog_managed_asset"."mime_type" IN ('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp')
        AND "catalog_managed_asset"."width" > 0 AND "catalog_managed_asset"."height" > 0
      ) OR (
        "catalog_managed_asset"."mime_type" = 'application/pdf'
        AND "catalog_managed_asset"."width" IS NULL AND "catalog_managed_asset"."height" IS NULL
      )

sales_order_lifecycle_timestamps_check.name: sales_order_lifecycle_timestamps_check
sales_order_lifecycle_timestamps_check.value:
(
        "sales_order"."status" = 'pending_approval'
        AND num_nonnulls("sales_order"."approved_at", "sales_order"."rejected_at", "sales_order"."cancelled_at", "sales_order"."completed_at") = 0
      ) OR (
        "sales_order"."status" = 'approved'
        AND "sales_order"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND num_nonnulls("sales_order"."rejected_at", "sales_order"."cancelled_at", "sales_order"."completed_at") = 0
      ) OR (
        "sales_order"."status" = 'rejected'
        AND "sales_order"."rejected_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND num_nonnulls("sales_order"."approved_at", "sales_order"."cancelled_at", "sales_order"."completed_at") = 0
      ) OR (
        "sales_order"."status" = 'cancelled'
        AND "sales_order"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND num_nonnulls("sales_order"."rejected_at", "sales_order"."completed_at") = 0
      ) OR (
        "sales_order"."status" = 'completed'
        AND "sales_order"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "sales_order"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND num_nonnulls("sales_order"."rejected_at", "sales_order"."cancelled_at") = 0
      )

sales_order_payment_timestamps_check.name: sales_order_payment_timestamps_check
sales_order_payment_timestamps_check.value:
("sales_order"."payment_status" <> 'paid' OR "sales_order"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("sales_order"."payment_status" <> 'refunded' OR "sales_order"."refunded_at" IS NOT NULL)

sales_order_revision_contact_check.name: sales_order_revision_contact_check
sales_order_revision_contact_check.value:
char_length("sales_order_revision"."customer_name") BETWEEN 2 AND 100
        AND char_length("sales_order_revision"."customer_phone") BETWEEN 7 AND 32
        AND char_length("sales_order_revision"."customer_phone_normalized") BETWEEN 7 AND 21
        AND char_length("sales_order_revision"."customer_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
        AND char_length("sales_order_revision"."customer_email_normalized") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
        AND char_length("sales_order_revision"."city") BETWEEN 2 AND 120
        AND char_length("sales_order_revision"."city_normalized") BETWEEN 2 AND 120
        AND char_length("sales_order_revision"."delivery_address") BETWEEN 5 AND 500
        AND ("sales_order_revision"."customer_note" IS NULL OR char_length("sales_order_revision"."customer_note") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000)

sales_order_revision_totals_check.name: sales_order_revision_totals_check
sales_order_revision_totals_check.value:
"sales_order_revision"."catalog_subtotal_gross_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_revision"."promotion_discount_gross_minor" >= 0
        AND "sales_order_revision"."items_net_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_revision"."items_vat_minor" >= 0
        AND "sales_order_revision"."items_gross_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_revision"."total_net_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_revision"."total_vat_minor" >= 0
        AND "sales_order_revision"."total_gross_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_revision"."items_net_minor" + "sales_order_revision"."items_vat_minor" = "sales_order_revision"."items_gross_minor"
        AND "sales_order_revision"."catalog_subtotal_gross_minor" - "sales_order_revision"."promotion_discount_gross_minor" + "sales_order_revision"."item_adjustment_gross_minor" = "sales_order_revision"."items_gross_minor"
        AND "sales_order_revision"."order_adjustment_net_minor" + "sales_order_revision"."order_adjustment_vat_minor" = "sales_order_revision"."order_adjustment_gross_minor"
        AND "sales_order_revision"."items_net_minor" + "sales_order_revision"."order_adjustment_net_minor" = "sales_order_revision"."total_net_minor"
        AND "sales_order_revision"."items_vat_minor" + "sales_order_revision"."order_adjustment_vat_minor" = "sales_order_revision"."total_vat_minor"
        AND "sales_order_revision"."items_gross_minor" + "sales_order_revision"."order_adjustment_gross_minor" = "sales_order_revision"."total_gross_minor"

sales_order_item_snapshot_identity_check.name: sales_order_item_snapshot_identity_check
sales_order_item_snapshot_identity_check.value:
"sales_order_item_snapshot"."position" >= 0
        AND char_length("sales_order_item_snapshot"."sku") BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND char_length("sales_order_item_snapshot"."localized_title") BETWEEN 1 AND 200
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."title_locale" IN ('bg', 'en', 'tr', 'uk')
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."quantity" BETWEEN 1 AND 999

sales_order_item_snapshot_money_check.name: sales_order_item_snapshot_money_check
sales_order_item_snapshot_money_check.value:
"sales_order_item_snapshot"."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."vat_rate_basis_points" = 2000
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."catalog_unit_net_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."catalog_unit_gross_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_unit_discount_gross_minor" >= 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."catalog_unit_gross_minor" - "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_unit_discount_gross_minor" = "sales_order_item_snapshot"."effective_catalog_unit_gross_minor"
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."effective_catalog_unit_net_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."effective_catalog_unit_gross_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."effective_catalog_unit_gross_minor" + "sales_order_item_snapshot"."manual_unit_adjustment_gross_minor" = "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_gross_minor"
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_net_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_vat_minor" >= 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_gross_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_net_minor" + "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_vat_minor" = "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_gross_minor"
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_net_minor" * "sales_order_item_snapshot"."quantity" = "sales_order_item_snapshot"."line_net_minor"
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_vat_minor" * "sales_order_item_snapshot"."quantity" = "sales_order_item_snapshot"."line_vat_minor"
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."final_unit_gross_minor" * "sales_order_item_snapshot"."quantity" = "sales_order_item_snapshot"."line_gross_minor"

sales_order_item_snapshot_promotion_chec.name: sales_order_item_snapshot_promotion_check
sales_order_item_snapshot_promotion_chec.value:
(
        "sales_order_item_snapshot"."source_promotion_id" IS NULL
        AND num_nonnulls("sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_internal_name", "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_public_label", "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_discount_type", "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_percentage_basis_points", "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_fixed_gross_minor") = 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_unit_discount_gross_minor" = 0
      ) OR (
        "sales_order_item_snapshot"."source_promotion_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_internal_name" IS NOT NULL
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_discount_type" = 'percentage'
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_percentage_basis_points" BETWEEN 1 AND 9999
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_fixed_gross_minor" IS NULL
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_unit_discount_gross_minor" > 0
      ) OR (
        "sales_order_item_snapshot"."source_promotion_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_internal_name" IS NOT NULL
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_discount_type" = 'fixed_eur'
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_percentage_basis_points" IS NULL
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_fixed_gross_minor" > 0
        AND "sales_order_item_snapshot"."promotion_unit_discount_gross_minor" > 0
      )

sales_order_price_adjustment_scope_check.name: sales_order_price_adjustment_scope_check
sales_order_price_adjustment_scope_check.value:
("sales_order_price_adjustment"."scope" = 'item' AND "sales_order_price_adjustment"."item_snapshot_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("sales_order_price_adjustment"."scope" = 'order' AND "sales_order_price_adjustment"."item_snapshot_id" IS NULL)

sales_order_price_adjustment_actor_check.name: sales_order_price_adjustment_actor_check
sales_order_price_adjustment_actor_check.value:
char_length(btrim("sales_order_price_adjustment"."actor_name")) BETWEEN 1 AND 100
        AND char_length("sales_order_price_adjustment"."actor_email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320
        AND "sales_order_price_adjustment"."actor_role" IN ('administrator', 'admin')

sales_order_audit_event_version_check.name: sales_order_audit_event_version_check
sales_order_audit_event_version_check.value:
"sales_order_audit_event"."mutation_version" >= 1
        AND ("sales_order_audit_event"."from_revision_number" IS NULL OR "sales_order_audit_event"."from_revision_number" >= 1)
        AND ("sales_order_audit_event"."to_revision_number" IS NULL OR "sales_order_audit_event"."to_revision_number" >= 1)

sales_order_audit_event_actor_check.name: sales_order_audit_event_actor_check
sales_order_audit_event_actor_check.value:
(
        "sales_order_audit_event"."actor_kind" = 'guest'
        AND num_nonnulls("sales_order_audit_event"."actor_user_id", "sales_order_audit_event"."actor_name", "sales_order_audit_event"."actor_email", "sales_order_audit_event"."actor_role") = 0
      ) OR (
        "sales_order_audit_event"."actor_kind" = 'administrator'
        AND "sales_order_audit_event"."actor_name" IS NOT NULL
        AND "sales_order_audit_event"."actor_email" IS NOT NULL
        AND "sales_order_audit_event"."actor_role" IN ('administrator', 'admin')
      )

sales_order_audit_event_order_status_che.name: sales_order_audit_event_order_status_check
sales_order_audit_event_order_status_che.value:
("sales_order_audit_event"."from_order_status" IS NULL OR "sales_order_audit_event"."from_order_status" IN ('pending_approval', 'approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'completed'))
        AND ("sales_order_audit_event"."to_order_status" IS NULL OR "sales_order_audit_event"."to_order_status" IN ('pending_approval', 'approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'completed'))

sales_order_audit_event_payment_status_c.name: sales_order_audit_event_payment_status_check
sales_order_audit_event_payment_status_c.value:
("sales_order_audit_event"."from_payment_status" IS NULL OR "sales_order_audit_event"."from_payment_status" IN ('unpaid', 'partially_paid', 'paid', 'failed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded'))
        AND ("sales_order_audit_event"."to_payment_status" IS NULL OR "sales_order_audit_event"."to_payment_status" IN ('unpaid', 'partially_paid', 'paid', 'failed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded'))
